name: wor-flasher-release-tools
description: Release tooling for WoR-Flasher packaging; disk flashing remains in the shell engine.

scripts.check: bash -n src/lib/*.sh install-wor.sh install-wor-gui.sh install-wor-hook.sh src/macos-app/Contents/MacOS/WoR-Flasher tests/*.sh && node --check src/node/build-release.mjs && node --check src/node/updater.mjs && node --check src/node/package-macos-app.mjs && node --check src/node/set-version.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && node src/node/build-release.mjs --check --platform=all
